{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique channels:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Status distribution:", df['status'].value_counts())
print("Revenue sample:", df['revenue'].head())

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
phantom_revenue = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of phantom orders: {len(phantom_revenue)}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check if revenue is string with commas
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Revenue sample (after cleaning): {df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').head()}")"}
